title: 20 GiB rho with one-fold polynomial compression

claims.statement: Under the single explicitly disclosed fixed-SHA-512 random-function heuristic H in proof.md, the cold classical attack solves full-production supplied-P fixed-G1 pairing inversion into G2 with probability at least 0.39, using total work below 2^(16021/125) target-group-operation equivalents at fixed C=20000. All initialization, bounded rejections and failures, actual hashing, table construction, sorting/checkpoint lookup, transfers, verification and output are charged. Preprocessing below 2^76 target equivalents is included. Peak storage is at most 640*2^25+2^20=21475885056 bytes, below 2^35; advice is zero. The computation bound is deterministic even if H fails, but the success claim requires H. No ideal adding-walk collision law, entropy service or bank-window model is assumed. This is an exploratory analytic heuristic attack, not a practical completed inversion or unconditional fixed-hash theorem.
